facts.statement: MarvelGame/version.json holds `version` and an integer `changelist`; the changelist equals the build number in the mapping file name.
The game runs Unreal Engine 5.3.2; CUE4Parse profile GAME_MarvelRivals.
Vanilla content is 39 IoStore containers (global + pakchunk*) in MarvelGame/Marvel/Content/Paks with about 590k packages.
Mods load from Paks/~mods, including subfolders; mod managers deploy one folder per mod.
Mods need the ASI loader (Binaries/Win64/dsound.dll) plus the UTOC signature bypass plugin.
Skin assets live in Marvel/Content/Marvel/Characters/<hero 4 digits>/<skin 7 digits>/ with Meshes/, Materials/, Materials/Lobby/, Textures/ and Post_<skin>_Physics / Post_<skin>_Lobby_Physics.
A skin id has 7 digits; its first 4 are the hero id.
A skin's materials can reference textures and parent materials of another skin id of the same hero (MI_1061303_Body_01 has parent M_1061001_Skin).
Skin VFX meshes and textures live under Marvel/Content/Marvel/VFX/{Meshes,Textures}/Characters/<hero>/<skin>/.
A mod is three files <Name>_9999999_P.{pak,utoc,ucas}; mount point ../../../.
Community mods show container_flags Compressed|Indexed or Indexed; compression Oodle.
Since Season 11 the anti-cheat reports encrypted, obfuscated and stripped mods; emit plain containers only.
retoc-rivals-cli pack <rawdir> --output <dir> names the output after the input folder and appends _9999999_P; default compression Oodle.
UAssetTool extract_iostore_legacy without --mod loads only top-level game containers, so ~mods can never leak into a vanilla base.
extract_iostore_legacy --filter is a substring match: SK_1061_1061303 also matches the _Lobby mesh and _Lobby_Physics.
extract_texture fails with an empty-path error when the output is a bare file name; pass absolute paths.
UAssetTool downloads oo2core_9_win64.dll next to its exe on the first extraction when it is missing.
list_iostore <Paks dir> --filter Characters/ lists ~134k vanilla packages in about 5 s; lines look like `../../../<path>.uasset [.ubulk|no bulk]  (export=N b bulk=N b)`.
inject_texture keeps the vanilla pixel format and writes the full mip chain (.uasset .uexp .ubulk .uptnl) by default.
T_1061303_Body_01_D (2048x2048, PF_DXT1, 12 mips) edited, injected, packed and extracted back differs from the edit by RMSE 0.27% (block compression only).
UAssetTool to_json -> from_json keeps every parameter of a MaterialInstanceConstant (26/26 on MI_1061303_Body_01); .uexp is byte-identical and an edited vector reads back.
UAssetTool JSON writes some zero floats as strings ("+0", "-0"); readers must accept both.
SK_1061_1061303 has 18 material slots; slots carry MaterialTag.* gameplay tags that must survive a mesh rebuild.
fmodel-mcp exports SK_1061_1061303 as .uemodel + material JSON + PNG in about 17 s; with an override mod deployed it exports the mod's version.
Blender 5.3 imports .uemodel headless through ueformat-blender without installing the add-on: 81,410 vertices, 18 materials, 488 bones.
Opening a folder of loose legacy packages in fmodel-mcp mounts but mesh conversion fails; do not use loose folders as a vanilla source.
Mappings come from SpaceDepot/rivals-depot usmap/ named 5.3.2-<build>+++depot_marvel+S<season>_release-Marvel.usmap.
The hero/skin name table is a snapshot of repak-rivals character_data.json (April 2026); newer skins appear in the index without names.
Among mods providing the same package, the later-sorted folder is assumed to win.
Textures injected at a different resolution than vanilla are assumed to load.
